title: Report of the fixer for one key and one pass of the fix mode
description: Content of fix/<repo>/report-<N>.json, checked by cqa_fix.py validate <run_dir> <key> report --pass <N> (exit 6 with the list of errors). One row per row of the dispatch, all of the section of pass N; every row of that section still pending in the state must be there. Texts a reviewer or a lead dev reads (change, uat, remaining, reason, question, attention) are written in French. A valid report updates the rows of fix/state.json.

key.description: Key of the pass: the name of the repo, as in the Fix: field of the dispatch.

pass.description: Number of the pass, as in the Pass: field of the dispatch.

rows.description: One entry per row. A ref that is not a row of the section of the pass (« Réf d'une autre section (<alias>) », « Réf hors de cette clé »), or that appears twice, is rejected.

ref.description: Ref of the checklist row, as an integer (107 for CQ-107).

outcome.description: fixed: corrected by commits of the branch (a row given up after its commits stays fixed, with an attention starting with « Abandon : »). skipped: not attempted, with the reason; no commit of the row on the branch. question: a decision is missing, the row waits for the answer; no commit of the row on the branch. needs_command: the fix needs a development dependency; the orchestrator installs it if the command has an allowed form (cqa_fix.py install) and commits its manifest and lock file, then the row is reported again in a correction pass; no commit of the row on the branch.

change.description: Required for fixed: what changed, in French, 1 to 600 characters.

uat.description: Required for fixed: the manual acceptance test a reviewer runs, in French, 1 to 600 characters.

remaining.description: fixed only, optional: what is left to do when the commits fix the row in part, in French, 1 to 300 characters. The merge request, the summary and Notion mark the row « partiel » with it.

commits.description: Required for fixed, at least one: SHAs (full or abbreviated) of commits of <start_sha>..HEAD whose subject carries the ref of the row, or the covered_by ref. A commit not yet recorded for the row in fix/state.json must lie in bases[N]..HEAD (made during pass N, after pass-start), else « commit hors de la passe N ».

reason.description: Required for skipped: why, in French, 1 to 300 characters (for example: déjà corrigé sur develop).

covered_by.description: fixed only: the ref of another row of the key whose commit also fixes this row (a commit carries one row only).

attention.description: Optional: what the reviewer should look at closely, in French (for a Semi-auto row, the À valider of the finding). A row given up after its commits starts with « Abandon : » and then holds 300 characters at most.

command.description: The install command, exactly one of: npm install --save-dev|-D <package>[@<version>]..., npm install --save-exact <package>@<version>, npm install --package-lock-only, composer require --dev <vendor/package>[:<version>]..., composer update --lock, yarn add --dev <package>, pnpm add -D <package>. Single spaces, public registry names only (no URL, path or git+), no other option, no shell character. The fixer never runs it: the orchestrator rebuilds it from these parts, and refuses any other text (exit 5).

dir.description: The folder of the repo that holds the manifest (package.json or composer.json), relative, without .. or a trailing /, an empty text for the root.

reason.description: Why the fix needs this dependency, in French, 1 to 300 characters. Kept as the reason of the row in the state.

text.description: The question for the lead, in French. Its text is kept as the reason of the row in the state.

options.description: The possible answers, in French, 2 to 4, each checked in the code like a fix. Never an option that leaves the row as it is (« ne rien faire », « laisser à un dev », « pas de changement »...): the orchestrator already offers to leave the row to the devs, and validate refuses such an option.

default.description: What the fixer would do without an answer: one of the options.

rows.change: Ajoute les en-têtes de sécurité dans la configuration du serveur web du thème.
rows.uat: Ouvrir la page d'accueil et vérifier l'en-tête X-Content-Type-Options dans les outils du navigateur.
